coverage.title: AI companies want to embed safety evaluators, but countries need their own
coverage.title_vi: Các công ty AI muốn tích hợp các nhà đánh giá an toàn, nhưng các quốc gia cần các nhà đánh giá an toàn riêng

summary: At a Rest of World event in New York last week, speakers explored how countries sidelined by the U.S.-China race can retain some control over safety standards as they adopt models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and others.
title: AI companies want to embed safety evaluators, but countries need their own
